chunks: He said: Abu Ubaydillah Muhammad ibn Imran al-Marzubani informed me, he said: Abu Bakr Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa al-Makki narrated to us, he said: The righteous Shaykh Abu Abd al-Rahman Abdullah ibn Muhammad ibn Hanbal narrated to us, he said: I was informed from Abd al-Rahman ibn Sharik, from his father, he said: Urwah ibn Abdullah ibn Qushayr al-Ju'fi narrated to us, he said:

I entered upon Fatimah bint Ali ibn Abi Talib, peace be upon him, and she was an old woman advanced in age, with a bead on her neck and two bracelets on her hand. She said: 'It is disliked for women to imitate men.' Then she said: 'Asma bint Umays narrated to me, she said:

Allah revealed to His Prophet Muhammad, may Allah bless him and his family, and the revelation overwhelmed him. So Ali ibn Abi Talib, blessings of Allah upon him, covered him with his garment until the sun set. When it was relieved from him, peace be upon him, he said: 'O Ali, have you not prayed the Asr prayer?' He said: 'No, O Messenger of Allah, I was occupied from it by you.' So the Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and his family, said: 'O Allah, return the sun for Ali ibn Abi Talib, peace be upon him.' And it had already set, but it returned until the sun reached my room and half the mosque.

key_terms.اردد الشمس: return the sun - the prophetic supplication for a miracle
key_terms.فتغشاه الوحي: the revelation overwhelmed him - the physical state during Quranic revelation
key_terms.مسكتان: two bracelets - ornamental bangles worn by women

ai.seo_question: What is the hadith about the sun being returned for Ali ibn Abi Talib to pray Asr?
ai.summary: This narrative, transmitted through a chain of Kufan and Baghdadi scholars, records Urwah al-Ju'fi's visit to the elderly Fatimah bint Ali ibn Abi Talib (AS). She was wearing a bead necklace and two bracelets, and remarked that it is disliked for women to imitate men in appearance. She then related from Asma bint Umays the famous account of the sun being returned for Ali (AS): when revelation descended upon the Prophet and Ali covered him with his garment until the sun set, the Prophet prayed to Allah to bring back the sun so Ali could pray Asr, and the sun returned until it reached Asma's room and half the mosque.

en.mulla-asgharali-m-m-jaffer: 3. He said: Abu Ubaidullah Muhammad ibn Imran al-Marzbani reported to me from Abu Bakr Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa al-Makki, who reported from al-Sheikh al-Swaleh Abu Abdil Rahman Abdullah ibn Muhammad ibn Hanbal, who reportted from Abdul Rahman ibn Sharik, from his father, who reported that Urwah ibn Abdillah ibn Qyshayr al-Ja’fiy said:

(Once) I called upon Fatimah, daughter of ‘Ali ibn Abi Talib, peace be upon him, when she was quite advanced in age. She wore beads around her neck and two bangles on her hands, and she said: "It is abominable for women to resemble men." Then she said: "Asma ibn Umays reported to me that,

once, the revelation from Allah descended upon His Prophet, peace be upon him and his progeny, and it overwhelmed him. ‘Ali ibn Abi Talib, may peace be upon him, covered him (i.e. the Prophet) with his cloth, till the sun set. When the revelation ceased, the Prophet, peace be upon him and his progeny, said: "O ‘Ali! Have you offered your Asr prayers?" He said: "No O, messenger of Allah! My attendance upon you prevented me from that." Then the Prophet, peace be upon him and his progeny, prayed: "O Allah, cause the sun to return for ‘Ali ibn Abi Talib". The sun had set, so it rose again till its rays reached my room and half the height of the Mosque."
